flags-help.stdout:
XMemo Standalone Skill Runtime

Usage:
  node scripts/xmemo-skill.mjs <command> [options]

Commands:
  login --allow-plaintext             Start formal device login and explicitly permit local token storage
  register --reason <unattended|declined> --allow-plaintext Start limited temporary memory only when formal login is unavailable
  logout [--revoke-environment-token] Revoke and remove a local credential
  auth status [--verify]              Show local or verified auth status (alias: auth-status)
  auth add --from-stdin --allow-plaintext Store a formal token read from standard input
  auth claim-status [--allow-plaintext] Check temporary-account claim status
  auth claim-confirm [--allow-plaintext] Confirm a pending human claim and accept formal token handoff
  auth claim-deny [--allow-plaintext] Decline a pending bind and keep isolated temporary access
  read --id <id> [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--bucket <bucket>] [--scope <scope>]
  update --id <id> [--content <text>] [--path <path>] [--metadata <json>] [--bucket <bucket>] [--scope <scope>]
  forget --id <id> [--reason <text>] --confirm
  ledger-list [--month <YYYY-MM>] [--from <date>] [--to <date>] [--currency <code>] [--category <name>] [--type <type>] [--min-amount <n>] [--max-amount <n>] [--limit <n>] [--offset <n>]
  ledger-summary [--months <n>] [--currency <code>] [--type <type>]
  overview                            Show account overview (memories, storage, agents)
  activity [--limit <n>]              Show recent account activity
  stats [--scope <scope>] [--path <path>] [--bucket <bucket>] [--memory-type <type>] [--status <status>] [--source <src>] [--since <iso>] [--until <iso>] [--group-by <dims>] [--top-n <1..200>] [--team-id <id>] Show memory statistics and breakdown
  remember (--content <text> | --content - | --file <path>) [--path <path>] [--metadata <json-object>]
  recall --query <text> [--limit <n>] [--explain <true|false>] [--prefer_working <true|false>] [--compact]
  search --query <text> [--limit <n>] [--explain <true|false>] [--prefer_working <true|false>] [--compact]
  recall-context --query <text> [--max_items <n>] [--max_tokens <n>] [--prefer_working <true|false>] [--include_knowledge <true|false>] Read-only bounded Memory context; opt into Knowledge with true
  save-state --key <key> [--content <text>] [--ttl_seconds <0..604800>] (alias: state-save)
  restore-state --key <key>           (alias: state-restore)
  restart-snapshot [--state_key <key>] [--session_id <id>] [--ttl_seconds <0..2592000>] Save a full restart-continuity snapshot
  restart-restore [--snapshot_id <id> | --source_session_id <id>] [--target_session_id <id>] Restore the latest or selected restart snapshot
  todo-add --content <text>
  todo-list
  todo-done --id <todo_id>
  expense-add --item <text> --amount <number> --currency <code>
  doctor [--anonymous]

Credential resolution:
  XMEMO_KEY                          Preferred; never copied to the local credential file
  User credential file               Read only as a fallback

Global options:
  --json                             Print the API response as JSON
  --terminal                         Force human-readable terminal output even when piped
  --base-url <url>                   Override https://xmemo.dev; HTTPS or loopback HTTP only
  --timeout-ms <ms>                  Per-request timeout (default: 30000)
  --compact                          Shorten recall/search content for terminals
  --allow-plaintext                  Explicitly permit unencrypted user-file credential storage
  --version                          Show the Skill runtime version
  --help, -h                         Show this help

Run `node scripts/xmemo-skill.mjs <command> --help` for command-specific usage.
